title: Block Oscillator Action Factorization
body_html:
Block Oscillator Action Factorization

Under the residual decomposition \[ S(b)=S({}^\boxplus b)\otimes S({}^\boxminus b), \] the translated orbit representation factors as \[ \omega_w={}^\boxplus\omega_S\otimes{}^\boxminus\omega \] as a module for \({}^\boxplus S\ltimes{}^\boxminus J_M\).
proof_html: For \(h\in{}^\boxplus S\), the displacement \(h^{-1}w-w\) lies in the block-diagonal lattice quotient, so the generalized lattice-model formula acts only on \(S({}^\boxplus b)\), while the off-diagonal factor is the pulled-back linear action. For \(h\in{}^\boxminus J_M\), the linear action on \(S({}^\boxplus b)\) is trivial and the translation lies in \({}^\boxminus b\), giving exactly \({}^\boxminus\omega\). These two cases generate the semidirect product.
